KEY LESSON: the STRONGER member made the WORSE ensemble. Kaggle-trained pseudo-RGB m alone 0.70297 > local pseudo-RGB m alone 0.70183, but ensembling it gives 0.70875 (w0.8; w1.0 0.70821, w0.6 0.70844) vs 0.71079 with the local one. The Kaggle prgb-m shares hyperparameters with the hsi16 m member (30 epochs, batch 8, seed 2026, same schedule) so their errors correlate; the local one differs (60 epochs, batch 3). For ensembles, pick members that were trained DIFFERENTLY, not members that score higher alone
